items.text_en: Wait for the first real rain in mid month 11. Within two weeks every weed seed in the ground has germinated.
items.text_hr: Čekaj prvu pravu kišu sredinom 11. mjeseca. U dva tjedna proklija svako sjeme korova u zemlji.

items.text_en: In early month 12, shallow till the whole plot once. That single pass kills the entire flush of young weeds at once.
items.text_hr: Početkom 12. mjeseca jednom plitko obradi cijelu parcelu. Taj jedan prolaz odjednom uništi cijeli val mladog korova.

items.text_en: Walk behind and broadcast the seed with a hand spreader, wheat and fava in separate plots.
items.text_hr: Idi iza i razbaci sjeme ručnom sijačicom, pšenicu i bob na odvojenim parcelama.

items.text_en: Till a second time to bury the seed. Left on the surface, ants carry it off overnight.
items.text_hr: Obradi drugi put da se sjeme zatrpa. Ostavljeno na površini, mravi ga odnesu preko noći.

items.text_en: Do nothing at all until month 5. No compost, no water, no weeding.
items.text_hr: Ne radi apsolutno ništa do 5. mjeseca. Bez komposta, bez vode, bez plijevljenja.

items.text_en: Cut with a sickle, one or two hours each morning for a fortnight. Cut both crops together.
items.text_hr: Reži srpom, sat ili dva svako jutro dva tjedna. Obje kulture reži zajedno.

items.text_en: Thresh and winnow, then store dry in sealed barrels.
items.text_hr: Ovrši i provijaj, pa spremi suho u zatvorene bačve.

items.text_en: Keep back next year's seed, and buy a little in occasionally to keep the genetics moving.
items.text_hr: Ostavi sjeme za sljedeću godinu, a povremeno dokupi malo da se genetika miče.
